about.title: About the Ursula’s Return set
paragraphs: Ursula’s Return is the 4th Disney Lorcana booster set, released on 31 May 2024. It has 225 cards: 204 in the main set, 18 Enchanted and 3 Illumineer’s Quest cards. There are also 204 foils, one for each main set card.

Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 204 main set cards), the Master set (408 cards, adding the foils) or the Grand Master set (all 429 cards, adding the Enchanted and Illumineer’s Quest cards).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details come from LorcanaJSON, card images from Lorcast and prices from TCGplayer.
